title: Small guide to understand pirated Movies and Show filenames
description:
Small guide to understand pirated Movies and Show filenames

**Common**
 **S01** for Season 1
 **E01** for Episode 1
 **PROPER** for A corrected version released by a different/same group.
 **REPACK** for A corrected version released by the same group that issued the original release.

**Source**
**Type 1 - Original (Recommend)**
 BluRay, Blu-ray for Blu-ray Disc
 WEB, WEB-DL for Streaming Service

**Type 2 - Encode**
Encode means encoded directly from an original source to reduce the size
 BDRip for Blu-ray Disc encode
 WEBRip for Streaming Service encode

**Streaming Service**
**** **AMZN** for Amazon Prime
 **APTV** for Apple TV
 **DNSP** for Disney+
 **HBO / MAX** for HBO Max
 **HS** for Disney+ Hotstar
 **HULU** for Hulu
 **IT** for Apple iTunes
 **JC** for JioCinema
 **MA** for Movies Anywhere
 **NF** for Netflix
 **PMTP** for Paramount+

**Audio**
 **AAC** for Advance Audio Coding
 **DD**, **AC3** for Dolby Digital
 **DDP, EAC3** for Dolby Digital Plus
 **DDPA**, **DDP Atmos** for Dolby Digital Plus with Atmos
 **TrueHD** for Dolby TrueHD
 **TrueHD Atmos** for TrueHD with Atmos
 **DTS** for DTS Digital Surround
 **DTS-HD MA** for DTS-HD Master Audio
 **DTS:X** for DTS with Objects
 **MULTi** for The release has a minimum of 2 audio languages

**Video**
 **AV1** for AOMedia Video 1
 **x265**, **H.265**, **H265**, or **HEVC** for High Efficiency Video Coding
 **x264**, **H.264**, **H264**, or **AVC** for Advanced Video Coding
 **HDR** or **HDR10** for High Dynamic Range
 **HDR10P**, **HDR10PLUS**, or **HDRP10+** for High Dynamic Range Plus
 **DV** for Dolby Vision with Profile 5
 **DV HDR** or **DoVi** for Dolby Vision with Profile 7 or 8.1
 **CBR** for Constant Bit-Rate
 **DS4K** for 4K downscaled less than its original resolution
 **RM4K** for 4K remaster in 1080p
